changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: AUDIO IN through the Rytm's own DIST, COMP, delay and reverb.
On the FX track's DISTORTION page, D (STE) sets the input into the mix before DIST and COMP, and E (IFX) sends it to the delay and the reverb.
Both knobs save with the kit and take parameter, scene and performance locks. Tap D to sum the input to mono.
Level, noise and latency are not measured; this exact package has not run on a unit.
Renamed Audio In Routing (was Audio In FX, id audio-in-fx), and the module page now credits the author as Nathaniel Pavel (@npp1993). No change on the unit: the knobs still read STE and IFX.
